system.description:
You touch a willing creature who you can see. You impart upon them the special sense Perceptive Authority for the duration.

Perceptive Authority. Creatures with this sense have a rank of mastery to Identify Genjutsu checks and 30 Feet of Dark Vision.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of target creatures by +1. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher this jutsu no longer requires concentration.
